author: Noema I
title: No-PE + Concat MHA + Offset Correlation Pooling
abstract: Add offset correlation pooling (offsets {1,2,3,4,8}) to the no-PE dilated DSConv backbone, fused with concat(mean, MHA). Hypothesis: generic pairwise interactions lift CRI-Off without harming other tasks.
